name: AeWF World Championship
epitaph: Held by the Evangelist entering 1998, teaming with fellow champion Snake Eyes rather than defending it alone on Thursday Night Whiplash.

name: AeWF Television Championship
epitaph: Held by Snake Eyes entering 1998, teaming with fellow champion the Evangelist rather than defending it alone on Thursday Night Whiplash.

name: AeWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Retained by the Snakes, Viper and Python, against the Dark Side in a double-pin draw on Thursday Night Whiplash.

name: AeWF King of the Air Championship
epitaph: Retained by Sean Waltman against Wardancer in a match ruled a double count-out on Thursday Night Whiplash, after which a three-way ladder match was announced for the belt.

name: AeWF Anarchy Championship
epitaph: Changed hands on Thursday Night Whiplash (1 January 1998), when Moo Kame submitted defending champion Dreamwalker.

name: AeWF King of Extreme Crown
epitaph: Reclaimed by Samael from Joe Mama on Vicious Circle Tonight, after Joe Mama barely contested his own title defense at all.
